text.en:
The following Transfer Certificates of Titles issued by the Register of Deeds of Quezon City,
Philippines, as well as subsequent titles emanating from them, on the following lots of the Malaya-East
Subdivision, Quezon City, are hereby declared as canceled and the Register of Deeds of Quezon City is
directed to issue a new transfer certificate of Titles in favor of the National Housing Authority.

The National Housing Authority is hereby vested with the authority to take possession of these
reconveyed lots and develop as sites for the construction of housing units under its Housing Program;

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 1st day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
